decision_verbatim: At least one preregistered Phase-1 gate failed materially on the production construction. Quantify exposed downstream statistics and regenerate only exposed campaigns under the extended-period construction on fresh ordinary TEST seeds as _w1 versions; frozen experiments remain untouched and are annotated for exposure only.

exposure_assessment.diagnostic: autocovariance envelope at the preregistered five-Tp initial-decay cutoff
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: No boundary-recurrence exposure for D1/D5/F1 scored units: terminal recurrence begins no earlier than 563.9 s, beyond their 440 s maximum within-unit lag. The early excess is physical narrowband coherence and is unchanged by 8x/16x periods.

exposure_assessment.diagnostic: Rice mean for sampled elevation zero-upcrossings
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: Any reported sampled elevation crossing rate for the parametric sea would inherit the 0.53% shortfall. No frozen headline reports that quantity directly; U1 lineage counts roll-angle crossings, not elevation crossings. The 8x/16x period arms do not remediate the fixed-0.05-s sampling discrepancy.

Campaign severity calibration remains conditional on the documented fixed-energy random-phase estimand. Suppression was preregistered as a characterization, not an additional gate; 16x periods restore suppression factors to 0.857--0.958 but do not contradict conditional frozen claims.

exposure_assessment.affected_states: softening step, Hs 2 m to 5 m
exposure_assessment.downstream_exposure: Boundary-local forcing has a much larger first difference, but D5/F1 scoring begins 240 s after the step and is not boundary-local. Frozen step records are annotated, not reopened.

regeneration.reason: No downstream frozen headline is exposed to a failure that the prescribed extended-period construction remediates; the only material construction sensitivity is the already-declared conditional variance estimand. Regenerating unrelated campaigns would violate the only-exposed rule.
